disclaimer: Demo catalogue: fictional GlowCue Demo products for illustration. Ingredient lists and prices are illustrative.

products.name: Gentle Cream Cleanser
products.description: A soft, non-foaming cream cleanser that leaves skin feeling comfortable, never tight.
products.ingredients_inci: Aqua, Glycerin, Cetearyl Alcohol, Ceramide NP, Ceramide AP, Cholesterol, Phenoxyethanol (illustrative)
products.usage: Massage onto dry or damp skin for 30 seconds, then rinse with lukewarm water.

products.name: Balancing Gel Cleanser
products.description: A low-foam gel cleanser formulated for shine-prone skin and the look of congested pores.
products.ingredients_inci: Aqua, Sodium Cocoyl Glycinate, Glycerin, Salicylic Acid, Niacinamide, Phenoxyethanol (illustrative)
products.usage: Massage onto damp skin for 30 seconds, then rinse.
cautions: May feel drying if used more than twice a day.

products.name: Everyday Foam Cleanser
products.description: A simple, budget-friendly foaming cleanser for everyday use.
products.ingredients_inci: Aqua, Sodium Laureth Sulfate, Cocamidopropyl Betaine, Glycerin, Parfum, Phenoxyethanol (illustrative)
products.usage: Lather with water, massage gently, rinse.

products.name: Niacinamide 5% Serum
products.description: A versatile water-light serum that helps the look of shine, pores, uneven tone and texture.
products.ingredients_inci: Aqua, Niacinamide, Zinc PCA, Glycerin, Pentylene Glycol, Phenoxyethanol (illustrative)
products.usage: Apply 2–3 drops to clean skin before moisturiser.

products.name: Hyaluronic Hydration Serum
products.description: A cushiony hydrating serum that helps skin look plump and feel comfortable.
products.ingredients_inci: Aqua, Sodium Hyaluronate, Panthenol, Glycerin, Phenoxyethanol (illustrative)
products.usage: Apply to slightly damp skin, then seal with moisturiser.

products.name: Vitamin C 10% Glow Serum
products.description: A morning serum that helps brighten the look of dark spots and dull, uneven tone.
products.ingredients_inci: Aqua, Ascorbyl Glucoside, Propanediol, Ferulic Acid, Tocopherol, Phenoxyethanol (illustrative)
products.usage: Apply 3 drops in the morning before moisturiser and sunscreen.
cautions: Patch test first. Always follow with sunscreen.

products.name: Retinol 0.3% Night Serum
products.description: A gentle-strength night serum that helps smooth the look of fine lines and rough texture.
products.ingredients_inci: Squalane, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Retinol, Tocopherol, Bisabolol (illustrative)
products.usage: Start with 2 evenings a week on dry skin; build up slowly.
cautions: Not for use during pregnancy without advice.

products.name: Centella Calm Serum
products.description: A soothing serum that helps calm the look of redness and supports a comfortable feel.
products.ingredients_inci: Aqua, Centella Asiatica Extract, Allantoin, Glycerin, Panthenol, Phenoxyethanol (illustrative)

products.name: Lactic Acid 5% Exfoliating Toner
products.description: A gentle evening exfoliating toner that helps even the look of rough texture and dark spots.
products.ingredients_inci: Aqua, Lactic Acid, Sodium Lactate, Glycerin, Aloe Barbadensis Leaf Juice (illustrative)
products.usage: Sweep over clean skin with a cotton pad 2–3 evenings a week.
cautions: Do not use on the same night as retinol.

products.name: Oil-Free Gel Moisturiser
products.description: A weightless gel moisturiser for shine-prone skin with a soft matte finish.
products.ingredients_inci: Aqua, Glycerin, Niacinamide, Dimethicone, Carbomer, Phenoxyethanol (illustrative)
products.usage: Smooth a pea-sized amount over face and neck.

products.name: Ceramide Barrier Cream
products.description: A rich, comforting cream that helps skin feel soft and look less dry.
products.ingredients_inci: Aqua, Butyrospermum Parkii Butter, Glycerin, Ceramide NP, Cholesterol, Phytosphingosine (illustrative)
products.usage: Massage into face and neck as the last step at night (before sunscreen in the morning).

products.name: Caffeine Eye Gel
products.description: A cooling eye gel that helps the under-eye area look brighter and more rested.
products.ingredients_inci: Aqua, Caffeine, Sodium Hyaluronate, Glycerin, Phenoxyethanol (illustrative)
products.usage: Tap a rice-grain amount around the orbital bone.

products.name: Peptide Eye Cream
products.description: A nourishing night eye cream that helps the look of under-eye shadows and fine lines.
products.ingredients_inci: Aqua, Glycerin, Palmitoyl Tripeptide-1, Niacinamide, Squalane (illustrative)
products.usage: Pat gently around the eye area in the evening.

products.name: Sheer Gel Sunscreen SPF 50
products.description: A clear, lightweight gel sunscreen with no white cast, made for daily wear in strong sun.
products.ingredients_inci: Aqua, Homosalate, Ethylhexyl Salicylate, Bis-Ethylhexyloxyphenol Methoxyphenyl Triazine, Glycerin (illustrative)
products.usage: Apply generously as the last morning step; reapply every 2 hours outdoors.

products.name: Mineral Comfort Sunscreen SPF 50 (tinted)
products.description: A gentle tinted mineral sunscreen; the tint avoids a white cast on deeper skin tones.
products.ingredients_inci: Zinc Oxide, Caprylic/Capric Triglyceride, Iron Oxides, Glycerin, Tocopherol (illustrative)
products.usage: Apply generously as the last morning step; reapply every 2 hours outdoors.
